observations.title: FMD biosecurity and buffalo-fence inspections
observations.summary: DVS reported inspection of 9 of 29 buffalo-holding properties. Fence maintenance, compliance and buffalo–cattle contact remained priorities. Property-level identifiers withheld.

observations.title: Dipping infrastructure and acaricide availability
observations.summary: Fortnightly dipping continued, with acaricide stocks described as available across provinces; pour-on alternatives were used in water-constrained locations.

observations.title: Digital Stock Card adoption
observations.summary: The report recorded digitised dipping and quarterly livestock census entries from four trained provinces. Entry counts are not animal counts.
